items.briefing:
Mid-market Australian organisations should be on high alert, with new data showing firms of this size account for 73% of ransomware victims globally. Separately, a new unfiltered AI platform called "Kriminal" is making it easier for cybercriminals to craft attacks with no safety restrictions — raising the risk of more sophisticated phishing and scams targeting Australian staff. A Clop-linked web shell exploit targeting PTC Windchill software is also circulating, relevant to any organisation using that product.

Jamf has released AI governance controls for Mac devices in Australia and New Zealand, which may help organisations manage AI-related risks on Apple hardware.

**Tip:** If your organisation uses PTC Windchill, check with your IT team today to confirm it has been patched against the latest known exploit.

featured.title: Retailers widen security role beyond loss prevention
featured.summary: Security teams are increasingly being used to improve efficiency, safety and compliance as retailers seek more value from ageing systems.
